profile.name: Mohammad Mahdi Ahmadi
profile.intro: I build simple, fast and responsive websites with React and Tailwind CSS. I am learning every day and I enjoy turning ideas into working web apps.
profile.bio: I am a beginner web developer who loves building things for the browser. I started with HTML and CSS, then learned JavaScript, and now I am building apps with React.
profile.journey: During this course I built several small projects. They taught me how to split a page into components, manage state and style a responsive layout with Tailwind CSS.
profile.goals: I want to get my first job as a junior front-end developer, keep improving my JavaScript and learn more about testing and accessibility.

projects.title: Job Tracker
projects.description: A job application tracker that helps users manage job applications, track their status, and organize their job search. It shows how I use state, lists, and event handling in React.

projects.title: Shopping Basket
projects.description: A shopping basket where users can add and remove products and view their total price. It provides a simple and interactive shopping experience.

projects.title: Travel Packing
projects.description: A travel packing list where users can add items, mark them as packed, and remove items. It helps users organize their belongings and prepare for their trips.

skills.name: React
skills.detail: Components, props, state, map, conditional rendering
